documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome
Board Meeting Outcome for Outcome Of The Board Meeting Held Today I.E. Thursday, 29Th October, 2026
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation

analysis.summary: Menon Bearings reported robust operational and financial performance for Q2 and H1 FY27, characterized by significant year-on-year revenue growth and margin expansion across its business divisions. Management highlighted ongoing capacity expansions, strategic investments in automation and sustainability, and growing export opportunities, particularly in the US and European markets. The company continues to target high-margin, precision components while maintaining strong capital discipline and minimal net debt. Management reported a strong first quarter for FY27 with record-high sales, EBITDA, PBT, and PAT supported by healthy demand and operational efficiencies. The company expects sustained growth momentum driven by new customer acquisition, visits to North America, and upcoming railway and export opportunities.

guidance.claim: The total potential of additional business for the current and next financial year is expected to be around INR65 crores to INR75 crores.
guidance.quote: The total potential of additional business for the current and next financial year is expected to be around INR65 crores to INR75 crores, subject to good monsoon and geopolitical situation doesn't worsen further.

guidance.claim: Management expects the export share of total revenue to go up to 37% by next year.
guidance.quote: As we expect that by next year, the export may go up to 37% after total revenue.

demand_outlook.claim: The underlying demand outlook for the automotive and engineering sector remains encouraging.
demand_outlook.quote: While the global business environment continues to present certain uncertainties, the underlying demand outlook for the automotive and engineering sector remains encouraging.

demand_outlook.claim: The visit to Canada and USA is expected to yield substantial volumes in the coming period of the year.
demand_outlook.quote: That is because, more particularly, due to our last month's visit to Canada and USA, is expected to yield substantial volumes in the coming period of the year.

capex_expansion.claim: The company has planned a CapEx of around INR4 crores for this year in Alkop alone.
capex_expansion.quote: And we are having the CapEx of around INR4 crores of for this year in Alkop alone.

capex_expansion.claim: The Brake division deployed Rs. 0.58 crore capex in FY26 with Rs. 2.50 crore additional capex planned over the next 2 years.
capex_expansion.quote: ₹0.58 crore fully deployed in FY26 with ₹2.50 crore additional planned over next 2 years

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin reached 22.00% in Q2 FY27.
PAT margin reached 14.60% in Q2 FY27.
Consolidated EBITDA is up by 57% on a year-on-year basis.
margins_costs.quote: And EBITDA on a consolidated basis is up by 57%.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin in the brakes segment reached 25%.
margins_costs.quote: But at the same time, I would like to tell you that right from 12% EBITDA earlier, now we have reached to 25% EBITDA in brakes also.

orders_capacity.claim: Installed capacity for brake lines is 30 lakh units per annum.
orders_capacity.quote: Installed capacity 30 lakh units/annum for Brake Lines

orders_capacity.claim: Peak revenue from the bi-metal division can be above INR400 crores without any land expansion.
orders_capacity.quote: Peak revenue from this, it can be aboveINR400 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: CapEx for bi-metal and Alkop will be funded through internal accruals only and no fresh loan will be taken.
capital_allocation.quote: You see, so far as whatever we are considering so far as bi-metal and Alkop is concerned, it will be through internal accruals only, no fresh loan will be taken.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board of Directors declared a dividend of Rs. 2 per share.
capital_allocation.quote: Note: The Board has declared Dividend of Rs. 2 per share having face value of Re. 1 each

risks_headwinds.claim: Merchant export orders were stuck due to backlog caused by the Strait of Hormuz and war.
risks_headwinds.quote: But last three months, those merchant export orders were stuck because of backlog because of the Straight of Hormuz and the war.

risks_headwinds.claim: Prices of carbide tools have increased by 300%.
risks_headwinds.quote: Those carbide tools price are increased by 300%.

management_commitments.claim: Dual-CNC robotic cell installation is underway for November 2026.
management_commitments.quote: Dual-CNC robotic cell (AMS) Honeywell STT caps Installation underway Nov 2026

management_commitments.claim: Dual-VMC robotic cell execution is targeted for January 2027.
management_commitments.quote: Dual-VMC robotic cell (Brother) JD ISG parts Design complete; execution in progress Jan 2027

management_commitments.claim: Dual-VMC robotic cell simulation and design is underway for March 2027.
management_commitments.quote: Dual-VMC robotic cell (AMS) Honeywell STT housings Simulation and design underway Mar 2027

management_commitments.claim: Vision inspection and powder coating automation design exploration is set for April 2027.
management_commitments.quote: Vision inspection and powder coating automation JD ISG parts, Honeywell caps Design exploration with supplier Apr 2027

management_commitments.claim: The dynamometer is expected to be commissioned by the end of August.
management_commitments.quote: You see, basically that is under construction now and is expected by the end of August.

management_commitments.claim: The business from the railway segment is expected to start at around INR5 crores to INR6 crores in the first year and eventually go up to INR25 crores to INR30 crores within next two years.
management_commitments.quote: we expect that to start with, we will have a business of around INR5 crores to INR6 crores to start with and eventually it will go up to INR25 crores to INR30 crores within next two years.

management_commitments.claim: Management targets Alkop revenue to reach INR100 crores for this year and around INR125 crores next year.
management_commitments.quote: For this year, we are targeting Alkop for INR100 crores, next year around INR125 crores.

management_commitments.claim: The share of EV in the Alkop business can be in the range of 8% to 10% by FY27 end.
management_commitments.quote: share of EV by FY27 end can be in the range of 8% to 10%.

management_commitments.claim: An additional Rs. 2.50 crore capex is planned for the Brake division over the next 2 years.
management_commitments.quote: ₹0.58 crore fully deployed in FY26 with ₹2.50 crore additional planned over next 2 years

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
